card.name: Inside rare names and brand names
card.fires_on: Partway through uncommon proper names and invented drug brand names, on a short syllable such as af, LA, RO or ac. The name is unfinished and the rest of it follows.

modes.label: Surnames
modes.description: The syllable 'af' or 'y' sits inside an uncommon surname or a rare word in a citation or byline.
modes.example: Elizabeth Zwa<<af>> is a Marketing Communications Specialist at Elsevier

modes.label: Brand drug names
modes.description: A syllable falls inside a made-up brand or generic drug name, often right before 'is contraindicated' or a percentage of patients.
modes.example: noncarriers (25% on KISUN<<LA>> vs. 12% on placebo
